cohort: 194 neonates treated in the Perinatology Ward of Wangaya Hospital, Denpasar.
finding: Birth weight, asphyxia, gestational age, and breastfeeding practices were significantly associated with neonatal hyperbilirubinemia, while mode of delivery was not.
mod_finding: There was no relationship observed between mode of delivery and newborn hyperbilirubinemia.
